focusScenarios.title: Производители обуви в Минске: уточнение типа + shortlist + шаблон контакта
judgeIssueHints: Полное отсутствие контекстной непрерывности: после уточнения 'мужская классическая обувь' ассистент просто повторяет тот же shortlist из 1 компании
Генерация шаблона сообщения неработоспособна — пользователь не может отправить такое поставщику
Broken template system - inserts user prompts as variables
Gives up after finding 1 result instead of offering alternatives

reasons: Ассистент застрял на одной компании (Глобал Шуз) во всех 3 ходах, игнорируя запрос на 3-5 производителей
Шаблон сообщения в turn 4 полностью сломан — содержит placeholder'ы 'уточняется', 'к меньше', не заполненные данные
Only 1 company found across all turns despite repeated requests for 3-5
Template generation outputs broken placeholders 'уточняется' instead of real content

focusScenarios.lastUser: Нужны именно производители, не розничные магазины. Больше интересует мужская классическая обувь.

advice.executiveSummary: Critical systemic failures in multi-turn continuity, template generation, and candidate relevance. 0% pass rate on UV001 due to 504 timeout + broken templates. S006-S010 show catastrophic candidate hallucination (cafes for ventilation, accounting firms for welding). Immediate fixes needed: template placeholder sanitization, constraint tracking enforcement, and retrieval relevance scoring.

advice.executiveSummary: The UV001 scenario failure reveals 3 critical bugs: (1) context persistence failure — assistant repeats same 1 company across all turns despite explicit refinement requests, (2) template variable substitution completely broken — outputs raw placeholders like 'уточняется', (3) retrieval gives up too early instead of offering alternatives. The 18% useful rate (MiniMax) and 27% (Kimi) suggest systematic multi-turn context handling issues. Focus on fixing template substitution first as it blocks all template-based scenarios, then address context window management and result diversification.

priorityPlan.title: Fix template variable substitution system
priorityPlan.why: Template generation outputs raw placeholders instead of filled values across ALL scenarios, completely breaking B2B outreach functionality. This is the highest-impact single fix.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Template-based scenarios should pass validation; users can actually send messages to suppliers

priorityPlan.title: Implement result diversification fallback
priorityPlan.why: Assistant gives up after finding 1 result instead of surfacing alternatives. Users explicitly asked for 3-5 manufacturers but got same 1 company repeated across 3 turns.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Reduce single-result failures; surface available alternatives when primary query returns limited results

priorityPlan.title: Fix multi-turn context preservation for refined queries
priorityPlan.why: After user clarification 'мужская классическая обувь', assistant ignores the refinement and returns same shortlist. Context window drops accumulated requirements.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Subsequent turns should respect prior context and refinement hints

priorityPlan.title: Add export readiness and B2B criteria extraction
priorityPlan.why: Explicit requests for 'export ready' suppliers and B2B equipment criteria are completely ignored in later turns
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Meet B2B-specific requirements in relevant queries

recommendations.expectedImpact: Turn 2+ queries respect Turn 1 refinements like 'мужская классическая обувь'
